description: What one node of an agent run represents. The kind drives the row's decorative icon, which is always paired with the state in words.

members.name: Agent
members.description: The agent that owns the run (usually the root node).

members.name: SubAgent
members.description: A delegated sub-agent the parent started.

members.name: Tool
members.description: A tool call the agent made.

members.name: Approval
members.description: A human approval the run is waiting for.

members.name: Step
members.description: A plain step of the run that is neither an agent nor a tool call.
